title: The Founding Identity: How Royal Challengers Bengaluru Became More Than an IPL Entry
dek: Every franchise starts with a first season and a first squad. Royal Challengers Bengaluru's began in 2008; what that year looked like still shapes how they are seen.
excerpt: Royal Challengers Bengaluru played their first season in 2008, led by R Dravid with the bat and Z Khan with the ball. Some of that first squad stayed long enough to become the franchise's foundation.

sections.heading: More Than an Entry
body: A franchise becomes more than a team in a league when it builds continuity: players, a home ground and a recognisable way of playing that outlast a single season.

sections.heading: What the First Season Did Not Decide
body: First seasons are not destiny. Results, squads and owners change; the founding year is a starting point, not a prediction.
The later history of RCB is told season by season elsewhere in this series.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: The Founders Who Stayed
body: Royal Challengers Bengaluru's founding identity rests on the players from 2008 who stayed. {{ev:fi-stayed}} of them played five or more seasons.
Those players are the bridge between the first squad and everything that followed.
